name: ormar-field-aware-mutation-event-stream
instr:
ormar cannot report field-aware logical mutations across assignment, relations, and persistence. Add one mutation stream for auditing, cache invalidation, and reactive behavior, with no behavior change when nothing subscribes.

Represent every observable mutation with an immutable `FieldMutation` containing its model, instance, field, logical kind, origin, old value, and new value. `FieldMutationKind` and `FieldMutationOrigin` are str and Enum. Every scalar, direct relation, collection, and generated-through field must expose its supported logical kinds. Through storage has no independent membership changes.

Give each model class an isolated `field_mutations` `FieldMutationSignal` for synchronous and asynchronous receivers. Finish delivery before the operation returns. Disconnection prevents later delivery. Receiver exceptions propagate unchanged. Publish once, after validation and logical completion. Stay silent for equal or rejected assignments, hydration, joined-row merging, prefetch attachment, failed writes, and rolled-back database effects.

Persistence events must reflect database-visible save, update, and delete outcomes. Publish only on commit, in completion order, respecting nested savepoints and outer rollbacks. If a nested write rolls back before the outer transaction commits, publish only surviving changes.

Relation events describe endpoint replacement or individual membership changes after both sides agree, independent of through-row mechanics and database row
